question: As per data released by Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy (CMIE) for the month of December 2022, ________ recorded the lowest unemployment at 0.9%.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Odisha recorded the lowest unemployment rate in December 2022, at 0.9%.
 
• This data was released by the Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy (CMIE).
 
• CMIE is a leading business information company that provides data on various economic parameters in India.
 
• Odisha's low unemployment rate indicates a positive economic environment and effective employment policies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy (CMIE)**

 
 
• CMIE is a leading business information company established in 1976.
 
• It provides data and analyses on the Indian economy, industries, and companies.
 
• CMIE's data is widely used by researchers, policymakers, and business leaders for informed decision-making.
 
• The unemployment rate is one of the key indicators tracked by CMIE to measure the economic health of the country.
 
 
 
• **Unemployment Rate**
 
 
• The unemployment rate is the percentage of the labor force that is jobless and actively seeking employment.
 
• It is a critical indicator of the economic health of a region.
 
• A lower unemployment rate generally indicates a thriving economy with more job opportunities.
 
• The unemployment rate can be influenced by various factors including economic policies, industry growth, and educational levels.
 
 
 
• **Economic Indicators**
 
 
• Economic indicators are statistics that provide information about the economic performance of a country.
 
• Common indicators include GDP, inflation rate, unemployment rate, and consumer confidence index.
 
• These indicators help in assessing the overall economic health and making policy decisions.
 
• Reliable data from sources like CMIE is crucial for accurate measurement and analysis of these indicators.
 
 
 
• **Employment Policies**
 
 
• Employment policies are strategies and programs implemented by the government to create job opportunities and reduce unemployment.
 
• Effective employment policies can lead to a lower unemployment rate and economic stability.
 
• These policies may include skill development programs, incentives for businesses to hire, and support for startups.
 
• Regular monitoring and adjustment of these policies are essential to adapt to changing economic conditions.
